scope: Cross-section unified horizontal-overflow root-cause audit and fix manifest. Synthesizes the 6 per-section audit JSON files into one operational story.
user_reported_problem: A lot of Studio OS pages break horizontally and cut off at the edge of the screen, especially inside the Experience menu.

root_cause_summary.headline: Single-point systemic root cause was the shared rail link rule in static/css/studio-mode-rail.css consumed by all 4 mode rails (Experience + Output + Automation + Launch). The rule lacked overflow-wrap / word-break / min-width:0, so long localized labels pushed horizontal scroll on workspace_main across all 4 sections.
root_cause_summary.fix_pattern: Fix at the abstraction, not at each call site. Same architectural lesson as v3.27.1 sticky+clip + v3.25.5 reveal-armed + v3.31.5 theme-attribute-contract.
root_cause_summary.fix_diff_summary: Added: min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; word-break: break-word; to the shared rail link rule that targets .experience-rail-link, .output-rail-link, .automation-rail-link, .launch-rail-link.

items.failure_mode: iframe lacked responsive shell; fixed-pixel default sizing
items.fix: wrapped in clamp shell with aspect-ratio + width: 100%; max-width: 100%
rebuilt as real context column with overflow-wrap rules

items.failure_mode: shared rule lacks overflow-wrap (root cause for all 4 mode rails)

items.fix: .rmc-automation-graph-scroll {overflow-x:auto; overflow-y:visible} wrapper — applies v3.27.1 sticky+clip lesson (NEVER overflow-y:hidden)

items.fix: .rmc-output-passthrough wrapper (min-width:0; overflow-x:auto) without touching the inner partials

items.fix: word-break:break-word on role-preview cards and metric tiles
container queries drive readiness-card and plan-card layouts so they reflow inside workspace_main

items.fix: applied PII-safe actor_display pattern + responsive flex

items.fix: replaced inline row with overview_command_cockpit.html include using .rmc-overview-hub-rail flex-wrap responsive grid

patterns_applied.name: min-width: 0 on flex/grid children
patterns_applied.purpose: Allow flex/grid items to shrink below their content's intrinsic min-width so long labels wrap instead of pushing horizontal scroll.

patterns_applied.name: overflow-wrap: anywhere + word-break: break-word
patterns_applied.purpose: Force long labels (localized text, vendor names, file paths) to wrap at any character if needed rather than overflow.

patterns_applied.name: Sticky + overflow-y:visible (NOT overflow-y:hidden)
patterns_applied.purpose: Lesson from v3.27.1: sticky+overflow:hidden creates a truncation trap where sticky pins the top while overflow hides everything below the viewport. Use overflow-y:visible instead. Scanner scan_sticky_with_overflow_hidden.py baseline 0 enforces this.

patterns_applied.name: Responsive iframe shells (aspect-ratio, not fixed pixels)
patterns_applied.purpose: Iframes use width:100%; max-width:100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10 (or similar) so they scale with viewport instead of forcing fixed height that overflows on narrow viewports.

patterns_applied.name: Container queries (not just media queries)
patterns_applied.purpose: Layouts reflow based on parent container width, not viewport. Allows cockpits to look right inside both narrow workspace_main columns and wide standalone surfaces.

patterns_applied.name: Wrappers around pass-through partials (don't touch inner partials)
patterns_applied.purpose: When Studio OS includes a partial from another app (siteconfig, portal), we don't edit the inner partial. Instead, we wrap with a responsive container (min-width:0; overflow-x:auto) to constrain overflow without coupling to the inner template.

scanner_state_after_fix.scan_sticky_with_overflow_hidden: 0 (baseline preserved; new CSS contains no sticky+clip combos; .rmc-automation-graph-scroll uses overflow-y:visible)
scanner_state_after_fix.scan_theme_locked_token_text: 0 (theme-locked tokens carry theme-locked-allow markers where used)
scanner_state_after_fix.scan_inline_style_off_token: 0 (only inline style is template-interpolated swatch background)
scanner_state_after_fix.scan_undefined_css_classes: 0 (every new .rmc-* class defined in its CSS bundle)
